source_note: 2024年Windmemories实拍的最外侧无瓦顶石坊，三门四结构柱+双独立柱。剔除现代护栏和远处建筑，不混内侧三楼牌坊。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw the outer stone memorial arch 潞藩佳城 at the Ming Mausoleum of Prince Jian of Lu, Xinxiang. Photo 2 is its full frontal geometry reference. ONLY draw this FIRST OUTER arch, not the second roofed arch deeper in the grounds. It is a flat stone post-and-lintel ceremonial gateway with THREE rectangular openings and FOUR structural posts, plus TWO detached dragon-carved stone columns standing one at either side, SIX tall columns visible in all. The central opening and its rectangular lintel tablet rise above the two lower side openings. The four connected posts have squared caps, a small central lion-like crest above the lintel; the detached side columns have flat squared caps. NO tiled roofs, NO eaves and NO invented Chinese pavilion on top. Preserve the low stepped stone platform, massive foot drums, and three-bay proportions. Abstract the dragon reliefs as a few graceful fine contour lines within each border, no dense scales. Remove lettering in the lintel tablet, modern railings, electric fencing above the arch, scenery, people, distant buildings, all paving texture. Treat the side openings as white empty space. Straight frontal horizontal composition, the entire arch and both detached columns fully within canvas, fine sparse black line on pure white, landscape 1536x1024, wide white margin all around.

historical_sources.supports: 讨论新乡潞简王墓及其牌坊、陵墓空间与石构形制；建筑阶段按明万历时期处理。

site_recommendation.name: 潞简王墓
site_recommendation.sub: 潞藩佳城 · 明代石坊
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1615仅作万历晚期陵墓营建阶段的约略排序；不把网络所称“万历四十年（1615）”的换算错误沿用为石坊确切建年。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 新乡 · 凤泉区凤凰山南麓
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 公开陵墓点位，非石坊单体测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 潞简王墓前的石坊以三座方门组织神道入口，中央高起，两侧立着独立石柱。细密龙纹刻进厚重石材，把明代藩王陵墓的仪式次序留在山前。

facts.label: 陵墓
facts.text: 潞简王墓位于新乡凤凰山南麓，是明代藩王陵墓遗存。

facts.label: 石坊
facts.text: 图版选择外部“潞藩佳城”石坊，三间四柱，两侧另立独立石柱，未与内侧带檐石坊混画。

facts.label: 构造
facts.text: 石柱、额枋与抱鼓石构成入口，龙纹采用浮雕表现；图中按实物保留缺损与石构轮廓。
